description: The Dice Log tab renders attack resolution as a structured, step-based sequence instead of free text: a gold ⚔ attack header naming weapon → target, a ▸ weapon sub-header, numbered color-coded step chips (1· HIT 3+, 2· WOUND 4+, 3· SAVE 5+, 4· DAMAGE, 5· FNP) in a fixed-width aligned column with grouped dice icons and bold results beside them, dim indented notes for modifiers/keywords, and ✔/✘ outcome bands. Drives ShootingController._on_dice_rolled with a realistic full weapon sequence plus a DiceLogFormatter charge block, asserts every structural element in the parsed text, and screenshots the Dice Log tab.

steps.script:
var log = tree.current_scene.shooting_controller.dice_log_display
DiceLogFormatter.outcome(log, 'Bolt rifle complete — 2 casualties', 'bad')
DiceLogFormatter.charge_roll(log, 'Boyz', [5, 4], 9)
DiceLogFormatter.outcome(log, 'Charge successful! Move models into engagement range.', 'good')
return true
